text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Close yer eyes, and it all comes floodin' right back.
The biting cold, the quiet scent of snow fallin' soft and thick...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
My hometown was just a tiny village tucked away in the mountains.
I've been runnin' with everyone's cheers at my back ever since I was little—

text_block_list.name: Club Coach
text_block_list.text:
—Incredible, another new record, Yukino-san!
I knew it, you have the talent to compete in the Central League, just like Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Club Manager
text_block_list.text:
Ah, if only a recommendation slot had opened up back then...!
That prestigious Tokyo elementary had an unbelievable track record for getting into Tracen Academy, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Aw, awawawa... Y'all are makin' a fuss over nothin' again~.
Goin' to the big city is way too soon for a girl like me.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Besides... it'd be awful lonely leavin' the village,
and I'm worried whether I could make it on my own... ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Club Coach
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I suppose so... You're still in elementary school, after all.
As your coach, I just want to get you into a good environment as early as possible, but...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
S-Someday I wanna give it a shot, ya know? Maybe for middle school, or as a transfer...
Someday, for sure...! I wanna go to the sparklin' big city too...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Livin' a super chic, fancy life...!
Runnin' all shiny and bright in the Twinkle Series, and then...! And then...?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh...? What kinda girl do I actually wanna become in the big city...?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: —Haaaaah~~, I'm hoooome...
Welcome back, Yuki-chan! Great job at practice~~!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Oh my! Mifuyu-chan, yer here! Welcome, welcome.
Are ya already done with skatin' practice?

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Yup! I've finally got the afternoon off.
As a figure skater, proper rest is a crucial part of training too.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(Mifuyu-chan is my childhood friend who lives nearby.
We've shared a special little bond since we were tiny—)

text_block_list.name: Young Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
—Hey, Mifuyu-chan! Didja know?
We were born on the exact same day! My ma told me!

text_block_list.name: Young Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I know! I started skating around the exact same time
you started running all the time, Yuki-chan!

text_block_list.name: Young Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
No foolin'?! Guess that means we'll grow up together too, huh...?
We're gonna make both our dreams come true and do amazin' things!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
—That's what we always used to say, remember?
Hehehe!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
'Course I remember! "I'll race, and Mifuyu-chan'll skate!"
You've always been the best skater around, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Thanks. But there're so many people way better than me,
and I haven't even placed in a tournament yet. I've gotta work much harder!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, how was your practice today, Yuki-chan?
Hehe, did you set another new record~?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah... hit the nail right on the head.
I'm gettin' faster and faster, but... still...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...U-Um, Mifuyu-chan!
Could I... ask ya for some advice...?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
So, well... do ya think I'm just bein' shallow...?
I've just been wantin' to go to the big city for so long, but...

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
No way... Yuki-chan, you've been giving it your all this whole time!
Otherwise, you wouldn't be getting such amazing results!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
You've worked so hard for your dream of running in the Central League, right?
I've been watching you by your side, so I know better than anyone.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I know, but...
What does that "sparkle" I'm chasin' even mean, anyway...?

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Sparkle, huh... Hmm...
Oh, I know! Here, take a look at this!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh? Is that... a fashion magazine?

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Yep! It's full of stylish girls from the city.
This month's issue is a special feature on "Active Umamusume Racers"!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Whoa...! Gosh... she's so pretty...!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Right? Isn't she amazing? She's not just cute—
it says she's "The Ultimate City Girl, Master of Fashion and Racing!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
A "City Girl"...? That what they call 'em?!
She looks so cool, and so cute... Wowee...!

text_block_list.name: Magazine Article
text_block_list.text:
"—Q: Your recent race drew a lot of attention coming right
after a major fashion show. How did you feel going into it?"

text_block_list.name: Magazine Article
text_block_list.text:
"No matter what the public thinks, I just give both my all.
People questioned if it would affect my racing, but I won anyway."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Incredible... She really doesn't let anyone sway her...
She totally, completely believes in herself...!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Right?! Isn't this kind of person what you mean
when you talk about "sparkling," Yuki-chan?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(That's it...! That's the kind of girl...
I've been lookin' up to this whole time...!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(A girl who fights, wins, and uses her own strength to become who she wants to be!
Not just driftin' through life like me...!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I get it now... This whole time, that sparkling girl I wanted to be...
was a "City Girl"...!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
You can definitely become one, Yuki-chan! Absolutely!
That's why you need to go to Tokyo soon and see the wider world!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: To tell you the truth... I'm planning to go to an intensive training camp overseas soon.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat?! Overseas...?
Even as good as you are, you're goin' that far...?

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Honestly, my club told me, "At your age, without any tournament wins,
your time is running out." A gold medal is practically an impossible dream.

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Still, I don't want to give up...!
Even with a sliver of hope, I want to seize the chance myself!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Seize the chance...? I see...
Dreams ain't gonna come find me out here in the middle of nowhere, after all...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
My chest is just poundin' away...
I... I wanna make my dream come true too...! I wanna go seize it myself!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Mifuyu-chan! Thank you so much!
Thanks to you... my mind is made up!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I'm goin' to the Central League and becomin' a stylish "City Girl"—!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
—And so, after convincin' my parents and receivin' a send-off from the whole village,
I headed to Tokyo with just a few tears of loneliness in my eyes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—I first spotted that Umamusume on my way back
from an off-campus assignment one day...
—"Tracen Academy Love Pony Fundraiser"...?

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man
text_block_list.text:
Step right up! We're, uh, from the Tracen Academy "area"~.
Please donate to help underprivileged Umamusume children~!
choice_data_list: (Was there ever an organization like that?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, I heard rumors about charity scams using the academy's name.
This looks sketchy... I can't just ignore it!

My, the academy does things like this, too~?
I don't have much, but if it helps, take my money! Now where's my wallet...
Wha-whaaat...?!
